faq.question: Q1. What is KVS TGT Social Science Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive conducted by PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya No.1 Naval Base Kochi to hire a teacher for the contractual post of TGT Social Science.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for KVS TGT Social Science?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy announced in the notification for the TGT Social Science post.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview for KVS TGT Social Science?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 21 October 2026 (Wednesday) at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will take place at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya No.1, Naval Base, Kochi.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates must register online through the Vidyalaya website at https://no1cochin.kvs.ac.in/ and attend the walk-in interview.
